provenance.originality_statement: Independently authored first-party multi-region notification design exercise; no external problem statement, architecture, rubric, examples, or solution were copied.

source_notes: All tenant counts, traffic rates, SLOs, providers, failure cases, and requirement changes are fictional.
External question text and employer interview material were not used.
